acceptance_scope: Exact correction of the new seven-arm wrapper's carried benchmark-entry consistency gate, with prior unaffected wrapper evidence retained. Synthetic implementation only; not authenticated fill proof, market results, a frozen protocol or operations authority.

finding_disposition.classification: SHOWN exact source delta and independently passing synthetic regressions
finding_disposition.assessment: The existing controls recipe is available before carry validation. For each carried arm, intended positive-weight control components and original E are derived from the current bound recipe. _entry_evidence recomputes entered/missing components and status from positive nonterminal initial-E buys in that arm's carried trade ledger. The recomputed result must be ACCEPTED and equal the entire stored comparison_entry. All arms are checked before the simulation loop; copied empty cash proofs, wrong clocks and contradictory component lists can no longer authorize a failed benchmark.
finding_disposition.scope_boundary: This reconciles caller-provided carry metadata with its existing trade ledger. It does not claim tamper-proof persistence or independently authenticate a fully rewritten ledger/exchange execution.

Entry reconciliation depends on the caller-provided modelled trade ledger; existing financial resume checks remain required. This is consistency validation, not cryptographic provenance or real venue-fill authentication.
Failed initial benchmarks remain failed: no retry, later entry, reset, synthetic liquidation or cash-only relabeling is authorized.
Partial-period arm ledgers remain diagnostics. Top economics is usable only under the unchanged all-arm entry/completeness/end-B gates; usable synthetic plumbing is not an economic PASS.
One venue/common quote/no yield or FX and hypothetical full fills under explicit caller-supplied costs/precision remain the modelling assumptions.
Capital/cost/status/rounding/horizon/inference choices, data feasibility, profitability, liquidity/capacity and any market run or activation remain outside this review.
